prerequisites: Competencies from modules Object-Oriented Programming and Algorithms and Data Structures are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: know fundamental concepts, techniques, methods, and processes for developing larger software systems.
can analyze and model problems from application areas.
know design principles, modularization, and software architecture.
know testing procedures for software systems.
know version control of software systems.
know principles of project management, quality assurance, and software evolution.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental concepts, techniques, methods, and processes for developing larger software systems.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
